title: Finite exceptional constructions and normalized coefficient mate
statement: Fix the finite-field, coefficient and geometric data of [def-fix-six-functor-datum], the finite-Tor constructible domains of [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude] and [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility], the exceptional functor of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], compact support of [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], and ordinary pullback and internal Hom of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Restrict the existing quotient scalar extension and compact-support and exceptional functors to those full domains. Retain the unique etale-origin Hom-normalized adjunction and unique trace/evaluation-normalized dual formula. Define q as the full-subcategory restriction of the actual compact-support coefficient comparison, and b as the mate of q inverse under the normalized adjunctions. This relocates the existing construction block without changing its data or the two unique-existence obligations.
